items.title: Valero (VLO) Stock Looks Below Fair Value Despite Its 7x Run
items.summary: Valero Energy has been on a remarkable multi year run, so the key issue for anyone looking at the stock today is whether the current price still lines up with what its earnings can reasonably support. With that kind of backdrop, the real focus shifts to how much profit the business is generating for each dollar investors are now being asked to pay.
